title: CAT-RAG: Improving Secure Code Generation with Category-Aware Agentic Retrieval
title_zh: CAT-RAG：利用类别感知智能体检索改进安全代码生成

paragraphs.en: 总结：CAT-RAG提出类别感知的智能体检索增强框架，以安全类别替代CWE级检索，显著提升代码生成安全性并降低令牌开销。 Despite rapid progress in LLM-based code generation, security vulnerabilities remain widespread, and retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) can further amplify risk when retrieved knowledge is verbose or vulnerable to poisoning. Existing secure RACG approaches inject security knowledge at a fine-grained vulnerability level, causing prompt overhead and diluted model attention when a query implicates multiple related weaknesses. We propose CAT-RAG, an agentic security category-aware retrieval-augmented code generation framework. CAT-RAG performs adaptive category selection via an LLM as a categorizer agent and operates either as a standalone security layer or as a drop-in add-on to RACG pipelines, requiring no modification to the underlying model. We replace CWE-level retrieval with compact, language-specific security categories. These categories provide a higher-level abstraction over individual CWE weaknesses, organizing them by the security concern they share, such as Input Validation and Injection Attacks, rather than merely grouping related entries. Each category consolidates best practices and secure code examples into a single, prompt-efficient representation. We perform a comprehensive evaluation across CyberSecEval, CodeGuard+, and HumanEval. On CyberSecEval, CAT-RAG nearly doubles the secure code generation improvement over the state of the art (23.57% vs. 12.11%) while reducing token overhead by 41.71%.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：CAT-RAG提出类别感知的智能体检索增强框架，以安全类别替代CWE级检索，显著提升代码生成安全性并降低令牌开销。尽管基于大语言模型的代码生成进展迅速，安全漏洞仍然普遍存在，而当检索到的知识冗长或易受投毒攻击时，检索增强代码生成（RACG）会进一步放大风险。 现有的安全RACG方法在细粒度的漏洞层面注入安全知识，当查询涉及多个相关弱点时，会导致提示开销增加并稀释模型注意力。 我们提出CAT-RAG，一个智能体化的安全类别感知检索增强代码生成框架。 CAT-RAG通过一个大语言模型作为分类器智能体执行自适应类别选择，既可以作为独立的安全层运行，也可以作为RACG流水线的即插即用附加组件，无需对底层模型进行任何修改。 我们用紧凑的、面向特定语言的安全类别替代CWE级检索。 这些类别为单个CWE弱点提供了更高层次的抽象，按照它们共同关注的安全问题进行组织，例如输入验证与注入攻击，而不仅仅是将相关条目分组。 每个类别将最佳实践和安全代码示例整合为单一的、提示高效的表示形式。 我们在CyberSecEval、CodeGuard+和HumanEval上进行了全面评估。 在CyberSecEval上，CAT-RAG将安全代码生成的提升幅度相比现有最佳方法几乎翻倍（23.57% vs. 12.11%），同时将令牌开销降低了41.71%。
